title: Quietly Quenched Middle Eastern Lamb Kibbeh
description: A briny, gooey, Middle Eastern dish featuring pecorino and lamb, perfect for a brunch mood, made in a paella pan with a kibbeh form and low-fat friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Blanch the chopped onion in boiling water for 30 seconds to reduce its pungency.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, crushed pecorino, blanched onion, fine bulgur, spices, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Knead the mixture for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the mixture into small portions and shape each portion into a small kibbeh.
Heat the olive oil in a paella pan over medium heat.
Add the kibbeh to the paella pan and cook for about 5 minutes on each side, until they are browned and cooked through.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the kibbeh and serve hot.
